		<h1 class="entry-title">Scholarships</h1>	</header><!-- .entry-header -->

	<div class="entry-content">
		<p>Augsburg University recognizes students who have demonstrated outstanding academic, leadership, service, and extracurricular achievements through Augsburg’s scholarship program.  Due to the generous amounts of our institutional scholarships, a student’s total scholarship award plus any state and/or federal grants cannot exceed the total cost of tuition at Augsburg.</p>
<hr />
<h3>Early Auggie Scholarship</h3>
<p>Incoming transfer students who have an application received by the early application deadline will receive a renewable, $2,000 Early Auggie Scholarship upon admission.</p>
<p>*Applicants for the<strong> spring semester (2027) </strong>must apply by<strong> November 15, 2026. </strong> Those applying for<strong> fall semester (2027) </strong>must apply no later than<strong> March 15, 2027. </strong></p>
<p><strong>Amount:</strong> $2,000 per year</p>
<hr />
<h3>Transfer Regents Scholarship</h3>
<p>Awarded to new transfer students upon admission, based on their cumulative grade point average of one year or more of completed college coursework.  Recipients must be enrolled full-time in the day program working towards their first bachelor’s degree.</p>
<p><strong>Amount:</strong> $27,000–$31,000 per year</p>
<hr />
<h3>Augsburg Possible Scholarship</h3>
<p>The Augsburg Possible Scholarship program acknowledges academic success and is designed to make Augsburg University affordable for students with demonstrated financial need.</p>
<p>Incoming transfer students will receive the total cost of tuition (does not include fees, room, board, or books) through scholarships and grants if they meet certain eligibility requirements.  Students must submit the FAFSA each year and remain Pell Grant eligible for the scholarship to renew.  For more information and eligibility requirements, please see the <a href="https://www.augsburg.edu/augsburg-possible-scholarship/">Augsburg Possible Scholarship</a> program details.</p>
<p><strong>Amount:</strong> Full Tuition</p>
<hr />
<h3>American Indian Recognition Full Tuition Program</h3>
<p>Augsburg’s American Indian Recognition Full Tuition Program aims to support and promote the importance of American Indian students on campus. The program will cover all remaining tuition and fees after federal and state gift aid has been applied for eligible students starting in Fall 2022. <a href="https://augsburg.edu/american-indian-recognition" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://augsburg.edu/american-indian-recognition&source=gmail&ust=1644952814615000&usg=AOvVaw1NLHSHxdwrjwWfy5i-HjQc">Visit the American Indian Recognition Full Tuition Program website for more information.</a></p>
<p><strong>Amount:</strong> Up to Full Tuition</p>
<hr />
<h3>Augsburg Family Scholars</h3>
<p>The Augsburg Family Scholars is a program to narrow the opportunity gap for students with foster care backgrounds, beginning in Fall 2022.  The program is designed to work in tandem with the state-level support, but is open to any new or returning undergraduate student with a foster care background. <a href="https://www.augsburg.edu/augsburgfamilyscholars/">Visit the Augsburg Family Scholars website for more information</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Amount: </strong>Up to Full Comprehensive Fees (including tuition, housing, meal plan, and books)</p>
<hr />
<h3>Impact Scholarship</h3>
<p>The Impact Scholarship recognizes students who major in the creative arts: art & design, creative writing, film & new media, music, or theater. Recipients are required to live on campus. This scholarship renews yearly for up to four years, and is awarded based on faculty approval following an audition or submission of a digital portfolio. Visit the <a href="https://www.augsburg.edu/schoolofthearts/scholarship/">Impact Scholarship webpage</a> form more information.</p>
<p><strong>Amount: </strong>Up to the full cost of tuition for the 2027–28 academic year</p>
<hr />
<h3>Phi Theta Kappa Scholarship</h3>
<p>Recognizes academically qualified transfer students who are members of Phi Theta Kappa and are transferring into the day undergraduate program with one semester minimum membership in Phi Theta Kappa.</p>
<p><strong>Amount:</strong> $2,500 award for current PTK students as verified through a transcript or PTK advisor</p>
